subject: Re: Saturday cleanup
text: Heya, Good news, the Saturday cleanup is officially on, and I think it'll run smoother than the last one. We're meeting at the club shed at nine, so if you can swing by early, that'd be a lifesaver. I'll have the supply list on the board, but we'll need the folding chairs, a couple of hand trucks, and the extra trash bags from the storage closet. The usual crew is confirmed, plus a few folks from the neighborhood group, so we should have enough hands. If the weather holds, we'll break around noon for pizza; if it starts pouring, we'll move everything inside the covered area and sort recyclables. Also, don't stress about perfect sorting; the bins are color-coded. Just toss cans in green and plastic in blue. Bring gloves if you've got a spare pair, since mine always vanish before events. I'll keep my phone on if you're stuck in traffic or need a quick update, so ping me soon. One tiny favor: could you grab the label maker from the office shelf? It saves me a trip, and I'll owe you one. Reply when you get a sec so I can pencil you in. Thanks!
